privacy.title: Privacy Center
privacy.subtitle: Transparency into local edge data storage, transmitted parameter payloads, and security guarantees
privacy.local_data_desc: Raw camera feeds, individual vehicle speeds, timestamped counts, and license plate readings remain 100% on roadside edge devices.
privacy.cloud_data_desc: Only mathematical model weight updates (quantized vectors) and sample count tallies are shared with the central FedAvg server.
privacy.disclaimer_desc: While Federated Learning eliminates raw video/sensor transmission, gradient inversion attacks can theoretically infer partial properties. Future updates will introduce Differential Privacy (DP).
